notifications.title: The Shepherd’s Care
notifications.verse: The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.
notifications.homily: God’s care is not distant; he leads and sustains us like a shepherd with his flock. When worry rises, let this promise invite you to trust him for today.

notifications.title: Daily food plan
notifications.summary: A general, balanced one-day meal plan with an optional snack.

meals.label: Breakfast
meals.text: Oatmeal topped with berries, nuts or seeds, and plain yogurt; serve with water or unsweetened tea.

meals.label: Lunch
meals.text: Whole-grain wrap with hummus, leafy greens, and assorted vegetables, with a piece of fruit.

meals.label: Dinner
meals.text: Baked salmon or beans with brown rice and roasted vegetables.

meals.label: Optional snack
meals.text: Apple slices with nut or seed butter, or plain yogurt with fruit.

notifications.note: For allergies or medical dietary needs, substitute suitable ingredients and consult a qualified health professional when needed.

notifications.title: Beginner low-impact routine
notifications.summary: A gentle, no-equipment routine with easy movements and comfortable pacing.
notifications.warmup: 5 minutes: walk or march gently in place, roll your shoulders, and make small, comfortable arm circles.
routine: Complete 3 rounds, working for 30 seconds per movement and resting for 30 seconds between movements: March in place at an easy pace.
Shallow squats: bend only as far as feels comfortable, then stand tall; aim for 6–10 controlled repetitions.
Wall push-ups: keep your body comfortably aligned and do 6–10 controlled repetitions.
Alternating standing knee lifts: lift each knee gently, alternating sides at a steady pace.
notifications.cooldown: 5 minutes: walk slowly in place, then gently stretch your calves, thighs, chest, and shoulders without bouncing.
notifications.note: Move at a comfortable pace, use a smaller range of motion or take extra rests as needed, and stop if you feel pain, dizziness, or unusual discomfort.
